Recurring memberships automatically renew until canceled.

Members on a recurring monthly Community membership may cancel future renewals through their account or by contacting The Back Half. Cancellation prevents future billing only. Benefits continue through the end of the current billing period.
The Community portion of the Founding Architect Bundle cannot be canceled separately, exchanged, transferred, or refunded.
NO REFUNDS. Cancellation is not a refund.

tell: Do not promise a weekly, monthly, or dated Founding Architect Community communication calendar at purchase or onboarding.
Do not promise Community events, calls, or a member newsletter schedule before Community opens.

If asked about support response time, use the locked support expectation: typically within 3 days, with a goal of 72 hours or less. That is support, not a Community cadence.
Time zone is collected for scheduling, communications, community, and Journey timing. Collecting a time zone is not a promise of a Community schedule.
doNotTell: You will receive weekly Community emails / calls / events starting at purchase.

Founding Architect included Community access is the first six months commencing October 25, 2026 through April 25, 2027. After that period, renewal is $50/month.
Community Guidelines remain pre-Community-launch and must be finalized before October 25, 2026. They do not block August 31.

There is a substitute Community program between Blueprint completion and October 25.
Community-only purchase includes Journey onboarding. Production copy: Community access alone does not include Journey onboarding.
